products.title: The Luxury Gift Box
products.descriptionHtml:
Let's face it, we all love getting gifts. Especially when the gifts are useful and feel very personal to us, as opposed to generic items that could be given to anyone. The most satisfying of gifts are often ones that we didn't feel like we needed, but instead felt like a treat or indulgence.

 

 

This  Luxury Gift Box Set is just such a gift. It contains 4 items , luxury items in themselves, but also very special and unique to you and your lifestyle.

A gorgeous box arrives with the following:

  • Louis Roederer Blanc de Blanc Champagne . With a very delicate and pure bouquet,  the bubbles are slow , gentle and steady. The most perfect champagne .
  • The Jo Browne Gift of Sleep including two luxury bamboo pillow cases and bamboo sleep mask . 
  • Butlers Chocolates or GF  Chocolate Garden of Ireland 260g handmade chocolates  
  • Luxury Scented Reed Diffuser 

** Some items mentioned may be  out of stock due to unprecedented demand but we will use other similar luxury food items in their place .
